This constitutes violent criminal activity (assault/robbery), not a road accident, but still a high-severity anomaly.

A person is seen forcefully pulling or dragging another individual (partially visible inside the vehicle) out of the driver's side door of a parked SUV. The motion is abrupt and non-consensual—legs are extended outward as if being extracted—and the person outside appears to be exerting significant force. This suggests an assault or abduction, constituting violent criminal activity.

post_cbt.description: Two individuals approach a parked white SUV; one in red appears to confront or interact aggressively with the other near the driver's side door. The person in red then moves toward the rear of the vehicle while the other walks away quickly—suggesting a possible robbery attempt, assault, or suspicious confrontation. No visible weapon, but behavior is inconsistent with normal interaction (e.g., no greeting, hurried movements, positioning around vehicle).
